markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if all elections have been decided and margins calculated.
markets.rules_primary: If Maine has the smallest margin of victory among all elections in the 2026 United States gubernatorial elections as of Jan 20, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Margin of victory is calculated as the absolute percentage point difference between first and second place finishers. For two-candidate races, this is winner's percentage minus runner-up's percentage. For multi-candidate races, only the gap between first and second counts. For yes/no referenda, it's the absolute difference between yes and no percentages. For ranked choice/instant runoff elections, the margin from the final round is used. If no candidate wins a majority in Georgia and a runoff is held, the margin from the December 1, 2026 runoff is used.

If official results aren't available by the deadline but at least 95% of expected vote is counted, preliminary results are used. In case of identical margins (tied to the hundredth of a percentage point), tied options split the payout equally. Postponed elections or those without sufficient results by the deadline resolve to No.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
markets.rules_primary:
If U.S. corn yield per harvested acre for the 2026/27 marketing year is above 

181.2 bu/acre, as reported in the January 2027 USDA World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates (WASDE) report, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the “Yield per Harvested Acre” figure in the CORN section of the “U.S. Feed Grain and Corn Supply and Use” table, using the January estimate for the 2026/27 marketing year.

For this market, the first publication of the January 2027 WASDE report controls, including if USDA labels the figure an estimate or projection. Earlier reports and subsequent revisions, corrections, or reports will not be considered. If publication is delayed, the January 2027 report remains the designated report, subject to ECONSTAT’s expiration and contingency provisions.

The comparison value is fixed at 181.2 bushels per acre, the October 2026 WASDE estimate. Compare the published yield directly; do not recalculate it from production and acreage. For “exactly,” apply ECONSTAT’s two-decimal rounding convention, so a published value of 181.2 equals 181.20.
markets.title: Will U.S. corn yield per harvested acre for the 2026/27 marketing year be above 181.2 bu/acre?

custom_strike.Law: legislation that removes or restricts a power of the governor, or transfers it to another officer or body

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the law is enacted
markets.rules_primary: If legislation that removes or restricts a power of the governor, or transfers it to another officer or body is enacted in Ohio before Jan 11, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

For this market, curbing the governor's powers means legislation that removes or restricts a power of the office of governor, such as emergency powers, the veto, executive orders or the power to appoint or remove officials, or transfers it to another officer or body. It qualifies whether or not it names the governor-elect or also applies to the current governor. A law that only changes appointments to a single board, commission or council, only removes a reporting or administrative duty, or only changes the powers of other officers, a legislative chamber's own rules or local governments does NOT qualify.

No state's new governor takes office before Jan 11, 2027. Only legislation enacted by a state legislature after Issuance qualifies.

The effective date of the law is not relevant; only that it has been enacted.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if Seasonal Opening Operations occur before the specified date or if the Source Agency reports that the ski resort will not open during the season.
markets.rules_primary: If the first calendar day in the 2026-27 winter season on which Sierra-at-Tahoe conducts Seasonal Opening Operations occurs before Dec 13, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Seasonal Opening Operations require at least one passenger lift to carry members of the general public uphill for downhill skiing or snowboarding on terrain designated open for that use by Sierra-at-Tahoe.
The opening calendar day is determined in Eastern Time.
The season runs from September 1 through August 31 of the following year. “Before” excludes the specified date.
A name, branding, ownership, operator, or website change does not change the resort’s geographic identity. 
If Sierra-at-Tahoe is decommissioned, the market resolves to No.

Payout criteria
Access counts only when holders of a season pass valid for the specified season can use those lifts and terrain without an additional purchase.
Free reservations and passholder-only days count. 
Any number of lifts, any amount of terrain, and any operating duration count.

Doesn’t count for payout
Employee, contractor, invited-media, private-event, and separately purchased early-access or preview days do not count.
Scenic rides, mountain biking, hiking, tubing, and uphill-only access do not count.
Scheduled, projected, or announced opening dates do not count.
Wildfire recovery, repair, construction, or other non-skiing access does not count.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the Sierra-at-Tahoe. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If Chuck Schumer, Hakeem Jeffries and John Thune are each elected by their party caucus or conference as its leader in their chamber for the 120th Congress after Issuance and before Jan 15, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This must be confirmed, verified, or established as factual by at least one Source Agency before Jan 15, 2027.

All three of the following must happen for the market to resolve to Yes:
The Senate Democratic Caucus elects Chuck Schumer as its leader for the 120th Congress, whether the post is styled Democratic Leader or Majority Leader
The House Democratic Caucus elects Hakeem Jeffries as its leader for the 120th Congress, whether the post is styled Democratic Leader or the caucus's nominee for Speaker
The Senate Republican Conference elects John Thune as its leader for the 120th Congress, whether the post is styled Republican Leader or Minority Leader

An election by ballot, voice vote or acclamation counts. The three elections may happen on different dates; each must happen after Issuance and before Jan 15, 2027.

The market resolves to No as soon as a Source Agency reports that the Senate Democratic Caucus, the House Democratic Caucus or the Senate Republican Conference has elected someone other than Chuck Schumer, Hakeem Jeffries or John Thune, respectively, as its leader for the 120th Congress.

The following do NOT count:
The House floor vote for Speaker; only the House Democratic Caucus's own leadership election counts for Hakeem Jeffries
Election to any other post, such as whip
A report before an election that a leader is expected to win, is unopposed or has the votes

markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. holiday-season net retail jobs added for September–December 2026 is above 300,000 jobs, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market measures the net increase in U.S. retail trade payroll employment from September–December 2026 using BLS’s not-seasonally-adjusted “All employees, retail trade” series (CEU4200000001).

The expiration value is the first published December 2026 level, converted from thousands to individual jobs, minus the fixed September baseline of 15,378,400 jobs. The initial December estimate is used even if labeled preliminary. Later corrections, revisions, and benchmark updates to either month are ignored. No additional rounding applies.

The measure includes seasonal and nonseasonal jobs and reflects net employment growth, not gross hires or announced hiring plans.
